author: Linnaeus, 1758
habitat: 논, 밭, 습지, 하천, 하구 삼각주
summary: 비교적 흔한 겨울철새로, 중부 이남의 논, 밭, 습지, 하천, 하구 삼각주 등에 찾아온다. 곤충, 지렁이, 씨와 열매를 먹는다. 둥지는 풀밭 땅 위를 오목하게 파서 접시 모양으로 만든다. 국외에서는 유라시아, 아프리카 서부, 중국 남부에 분포한다.

points.ko: 녹색 광택 검은 머리와 솟은 댕기
points.en: green-glossed black crown with upswept crest
white lower breast, belly and flanks

art.subject: Northern Lapwing (Vanellus vanellus), adult in winter (non-breeding) plumage, as seen on Korean fields from November to February: black crown with a long, thin, upswept crest of wispy feathers; face whitish washed buff, with a white supercilium from the bill base over the eye and a black patch below the eye; chin and throat white; a broad black breast band glossed blue; mantle, scapulars and wing coverts dark green with purple and bronze gloss, narrowly fringed buff; lower breast, belly and flanks white; uppertail and undertail coverts rusty-orange; tail white with a broad black band near the tip. Bill short and black; iris dark brown; legs dull pinkish-flesh.
art.pose: standing in a field, picking insects and worms from the ground
art.scene: Korean winter rice paddies and wet fields near a river; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view standing: long upswept black crest, buff-washed face with white supercilium and black patch below the eye, white throat, broad black breast band, buff-fringed glossy green upperparts, white belly, rusty-orange undertail coverts, dull pinkish legs

adult male breeding (late winter to spring), side view standing: black crown and long crest, white face with a black stripe below the eye, black throat joining the breast band, glossy green back without buff fringes
adult, rear view standing: glossy green back, rusty-red uppertail coverts above a white tail with a broad black band
art.build: Medium-sized, round-winged plover, 30cm, about the size of a pigeon, with a stocky body, round head and a long thin crest curving up from the hindcrown. Bill short, straight and black, shorter than the head. Legs medium length, dull pinkish-flesh. Stands horizontally and feeds plover-fashion: runs, stops, tilts and picks. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. Tail short, white with a black band near the tip. In flight the wings are very broad and rounded at the tip, black above with whitish tips to the outer primaries, and white below with black flight feathers; the wingbeats are slow and floppy.
avoid: Do not paint a short crest or no crest; the crest is long, thin and upswept.
Do not paint the back plain black; it is dark green with a purple and bronze gloss.
Do not draw pointed wader wings in flight; the wings are broad and rounded.
Do not paint yellow or red legs.
